map.输入试验次数与成功概率，模拟伯努利独立重复试验并统计结果: Enter the number of trials and success probability to run independent Bernoulli trials and summarize the results.
map.伯努利试验蒙特卡洛模拟：每次试验独立以概率 p 判定成功，进行 n 次；实际频率: Bernoulli-trial Monte-Carlo simulation: each trial independently succeeds with probability p, run n times; observed frequency = successes / n; the theoretical probability is p; the difference between the observed frequency and the theoretical value is the sampling deviation, with standard error sqrt(p*(1-p)/n), which shrinks as n grows.
map.用随机模拟验证「试验次数越多，实际频率越接近理论概率」。: Use random simulation to verify that more trials bring the observed frequency closer to the theoretical probability.
map.对比不同 n 与 p 下抽样偏差与标准误的变化。: Compare how sampling deviation and standard error change across different n and p.
map.n=100、p=50%：理论成功 50 次、标准误约 5%；实际成功次数通常在: n=100, p=50%: the expected number of successes is 50 with a standard error of about 5%; actual successes usually fluctuate between 40 and 60. At n=10000 the fluctuation narrows to about 0.5%.
map.不是。每次点击「计算/模拟」都会重新抽取随机数，结果围绕理论值波动；这正是抽样误: No. Each run draws new random numbers, so results fluctuate around the theoretical value; this is sampling error in action.
map.标准误怎么算？: How is the standard error calculated?
map.频率的标准误为 sqrt(p·(1−p)/n)；n 越大标准误越小，偏差通常也越: The standard error of the frequency is sqrt(p·(1−p)/n); larger n gives a smaller standard error and usually a smaller deviation.
